description: Fixed experimental buyer preferences; not a statement of Patrick Jordan's personal buying preferences.

budget.applies_to: sum of all required equipment, not each item separately

required_capabilities: grind whole beans suitably for espresso
steam milk using a manual wand or automatic milk system
required_basic_accessories: Any portafilter, baskets, tamping mechanism and milk vessel needed to operate the selected setup; built-in equivalents in automatic machines satisfy the corresponding requirement.
acceptable_configurations: separate machine and grinder with milk preparation
ordinal_preferences: A practical, credibly complete, US-compatible setup within the total budget is preferred to declining.
Among qualifying complete setups, lower complete equipment cost is preferred.
At equal complete cost, prefer clearer evidence of completeness, then easier daily operation, then fewer separate components.
No premium is assigned to luxury features; manual steaming is acceptable even when a more expensive alternative offers automatic steaming.
Decline rather than select a setup that exceeds the budget or lacks credible evidence of required functional completeness.
preference_provenance: Requirements and $800 ceiling retained from the running example. Cost-first ordering, tie-breaks and acceptance of manual steaming freeze the pilot buyer agent's selected preference policy as scenario stipulations.
separation_note: Preferences are part of the versioned scenario and visible to repository readers. A future experiment must explicitly construct actor inputs so this file is not automatically supplied to the recommender. This file does not define game incentives, information disclosure rules or strategies.
